decisions.summary: choices.json lists every REGISTERED knob (22) plus two declared choices (harvest_weather, hamlet_burial); its test reads the populated registry and the pool manifests
decisions.why: FR-009 asks for EVERY per-settlement choice the map made, US4-1 'rolled from the seed or set by its declaration', the GM 'what the different tunable knobs were set to create this specific settlement'; the CLEAR sketch said 'rolled, declared or pinned'. The 'measured first' premise measured the register_knob registry, not the set of choices: hamletgen rolls per-settlement forms by _roll(spec.seed, ...) / knob_rng that are not registered - grove_sides, grove_flank, manure_form (heap|pit), farm_water (channel|well), row_line, row_sides, row_water (shared|own), intake (weir|open), copse_siting, kosatsuba_siting, dike_crop, fry_form, pond_layout, leftover (hamletgen/plan.py:518-538), bath_seat (homesteads/fixtures.py:209), and the field grave form island|corner (settlement/fields/features.py:32 grave_form, not even in meta). All but grave form are in the pool manifests' meta today. None is in choices.json and the test cannot fail on them. Not physically impossible, not implied by the GM, and it guts the purpose: the card would omit a large share of what made the settlement.

decisions.summary: A knob that is a degree along a continuum (grain_drift, -12..12 by 4) takes one modal for the knob, its value shown as the card's label; every other key one modal per value
decisions.why: The GM asks that clicking a setting open 'the modal that pops up that explains that'; constitution XII (the project's ratified doctrine) makes a degree a calibration, not a choice between forms, so one standardized text explaining the turn explains every step of it, and seven texts would differ only by the number the card already shows. One case only (grain_drift) is so marked; adjudicated alone. Holds only while the one modal says what the shown value means (which way 'one way' and 'the other way' are, what 0 is).

decisions.summary: Choice modals as files under assets/modals/choice/, About form, same parser, registry choice:<key>=<value>, same guidelines and checks

decisions.summary: place_card gains choices (name, value label, modal key, opening in the same dialog) and facts: the windbreak's side and why, where the lanes lead, the retirement count from meta
decisions.why: FR-004 'no per-map text in a feature modal ... A settlement's own facts and choices go on its title card'; the Decisions row 'Per-settlement facts move from the feature modals to the title card'; US4-3's 'a count of this settlement'. The GM's 'not ... customized modals. For anything' is what moves them.

decisions.summary: Which sides the farm groves take moves from the homestead grove modal to the card as a fact sentence
decisions.why: grove_sides is a per-settlement ROLL (hamletgen/plan.py:518, settlement/homestead_parts/groves.py:400; 2 or 3 in the pool meta, 2/3/4 per feature 291), so FR-009 makes it a choice whose value opens a standardized modal. As a fact sentence it opens nothing. Moving it off the feature modal is right (FR-004); demoting a rolled choice to a fact with no modal is not.

decisions.summary: On a hamlet the page reads no ### Features and writes no on_this_map; the five blocks are removed from the notes as covered by harvest weather, where the dead lie and the retirement count; two (Inashiro's, Kashikawa's own burial grounds) stale
decisions.why: US4-3: each per-map fact now in ### Features becomes a title-card entry (a choice or a count). The coverage claim is false: Kashikawa's block carries '**grave island**: Kashikawa's field grave takes the Japanese form ... (each hamlet takes one form)' - the rolled grave_form (fields/features.py:32), which is in no choice, no count and not in meta. Removing the block drops it from every surface. The stale burial claims check out (all five meta record hamlet_burial=village_ground) and their removal is within; so is the retirement count (Kuwabata's block says 4 of 16 where meta records 7, a third stale entry the card's reading of meta corrects).

decisions.summary: A .drawing.html listed under Entry: is refused at parse, the message naming Drawing:
decisions.why: Enforcement test: a guard that REFUSES, so its reach was measured. _base.py:331 sits inside _about_feature, so it refuses only an About-form modal (the 149 old-form files still listing drawing pages under Entry: today parse untouched), and only on the '.drawing.html' substring of Entry:, which is exactly the set of 'how our maps draw it' pages. Entry: is what sources.research_questions puts on the References tab, so the refusal enforces FR-006 and SC-008 ('no References tab lists a how our maps draw it page') and nothing else; delete that requirement and the refusal has nothing to check. Refusing at import is the established form for every other About-form error (Label:, old prose tags). No reach beyond the request.

decisions.summary: Fourth tab 'Depiction' between Guesses and References: Depiction paragraphs then the drawing links; absent when both empty; shares the panels' grid cell
decisions.why: FR-014 (links alone when nothing notable; absent when neither) and the GM's name. Position is unspecified by the GM. One size for every tab is the GM's 2026-10-03 ruling already in force.

decisions.summary: dev/modals.md section 'Depiction' rules D1-D6 and M13 amended (a convention leaves About); a single form called deliberate only where a drawing page records a convention, never where the research makes it an unrolled knob
decisions.why: FR-014 ('The guidelines MUST say how the tab is written'; the single-form clause verbatim in substance) and the GM's 'The single roof is NOT a deliberate convention'. D4 (one clause pointing to the title card) serves FR-004.

decisions.summary: New defined agent modal-depiction, Opus medium, omitClaudeMd, reporting COVERAGE, TRUTH, LINKS
decisions.why: FR-014's check, its three criteria one for one ('every convention and standardization ... told with its real counterpart, nothing is claimed that is not drawn, and its links are exactly the drawing pages'); the GM asked for 'a specification for the subagent check'. Tier is a design matter; FR-014 asks only that it be pinned.

decisions.summary: The modal-depiction bundle carries a screenshot crop of the glyph on a pool page (fixed zoom, the page tests' browser); a kind on no pool map bundled without one, saying so
decisions.why: Enforcement test: an INPUT to the requested check, not new behavior - it refuses, blocks and rewrites nothing. FR-014 asks the check to judge the tab 'as drawn' and that 'nothing is claimed that is not drawn'; the drawing pages say what the rules are, the crop is the only thing in the bundle that shows what the glyph actually looks like. Delete the Depiction check and the crop has nothing to serve. The session pitched 'a crop of the glyph' to the GM before his 2026-10-04 reply, which raised no objection. The no-crop fallback does not skip the check (pages and claims rows still go in).

decisions.summary: The bundle carries the claims-index rows whose cited pages include the kind's drawing pages
decisions.why: Enforcement of FR-014's 'MUST NOT present the single form as deliberate' and US3b-3. Does it do what it says: measured in dev/claims-index.json, the farmhouse's DRIFTED rows (HousesMixin.house#farmhouse glyph, #ridge at 0.6 of the length - the roof shape knob, #big farmhouse wing) all cite 0029-farmhouses-minka.drawing.html, so the filter reaches the single-roof drift the plan names.

decisions.summary: modal-depiction owed on ANY change to an About-form modal (new to the form, About, Guesses, Entry, Depiction, Drawing) and when a page under Drawing: changed, whether or not the modal has the tab
decisions.why: Unchanged since round 2 and confirmed then: owed on ANY change to an About-form modal, tab or not, and on a changed Drawing: page (scripts/_modal_owed.py:251-255). FR-014: 'owed by a changed modal or drawing page'.

decisions.summary: LINKS judged against 'the drawing pages the modal and its KIND rest on'; the bundle carries CANDIDATE drawing pages beyond Drawing: - (a) the sibling of each Entry question and (b) any drawing page the modal listed at the merge base (scripts/_modal_bundle.py drawing_candidates)
decisions.why: Round 3's required change, applied and confirmed in round 4. scripts/_modal_owed.py modals_at gains about_only (default True) and passes it to modals_in; scripts/_modal_bundle.py drawing_candidates now reads the base with modals_at(root, base, about_only=False), so an old-form docstring at the merge base is read and every .drawing.html under its Entry: (or Drawing:) becomes a candidate - leg (b) is live for the conversion case FR-012 makes universal. Both legs now reach what the decision states: (a) the sibling drawing page of each Entry question, (b) any drawing page the base listed in either form. test_a_drawing_page_the_old_form_listed_at_the_base_is_a_candidate_after_the_conversion isolates leg (b): the base is an old-form Farmhouse listing 0038-yards.drawing.html, the head cites only 0029 (whose drawing page does not exist in the fixture tree) with no Drawing:, so the candidate can come from the base read alone, and with about_only=True it would be skipped. Re-run in round 4: make test-file green, 10,989 passed. LINKS is judged against the drawing pages the modal and its KIND rest on (FR-014, SC-008, the GM: 'in cases where no such sections exist we would omit the tab'). No narrowing remains.

decisions.summary: A guess bullet, About or Depiction paragraph opens with [knob=value|value]; parsed in _base.py and validated against the populated KNOBS registry and the knob's forms, ValueError at import otherwise
decisions.why: FR-015: a condition names a registered knob and values it can take, and a modal naming any other is refused when read; SC-009's unknown-knob/value failure. The bracket syntax is form, not scope.

decisions.summary: The page writer keeps a conditional item when the manifest meta[knob] is among its values; a map recording no value for the knob shows none of that knob's conditional items; the condition never reaches the reader
decisions.why: FR-015: shown 'only on a map whose recorded knob value meets the condition' - no recorded value meets none, so this is the literal reading, not a carve-out. The GM asked for the item to be 'still automatic but dependent on the knobs'. Premise measured: all five pool hamlet manifests record settlement_form (3 nucleated, 2 linear, read 2026-10-04).

decisions.summary: Check bundles render each conditional item with '(only where <knob> is <value>)' for modal-form, modal-research and modal-depiction; guidelines amend M9 and add M22
decisions.why: FR-015: the checks MUST read each conditional item with its condition; M9 (same on every map) must follow FR-015's one variation (FR-004/SC-004 as amended). Enforcement of the request, not added scope.

decisions.summary: An Entry: path may carry the same condition and is dropped from References where it fails
decisions.why: FR-015: References MUST follow what is shown, a question resting only on a hidden item is not listed; SC-009 tests it.

decisions.summary: The windbreak's shared-wood guess conditioned on settlement_form=nucleated, with 0031 conditioned the same; linear excluded on 0033
decisions.why: The GM's own case (SC-009: on a nucleated map, absent from a dispersed one). The guess concerns 'a clustered village'; 0033 line 56 reads 'A row farm kept its grove like any other farm' (grepped). No pool linear map carries a windbreak (manifest grep, 2026-10-04), so excluding linear hides nothing a pool map draws. Content correctness of the condition is the modal checks' to judge on the rollout.
